content: Diligent Engine (DiligentGraphics/DiligentEngine + DiligentCore) is Apache-2.0. Cross-API abstraction over D3D11/D3D12/Vulkan/Metal/WebGPU/GL. Web search did not surface explicit confirmation of headless/no-swapchain Vulkan device creation; DiligentCore's EngineFactoryVk can create a device/context without a window in principle (used in tools/tests) but this needs direct source verification before relying on it, and the engine brings a large surface (shader cross-compilation via its own HLSL2GLSL/SPIRV-Cross fork, render-state-notation, multiple nested third-party deps) disproportionate to executing single render passes.
